messages:
kevin_peopleops: Creating a quick thread for Maya's Day 1 logistics (starts Mon 9am PT). Need confirm flows for I-9 since shes travelling and her SSN card will arrive later. Also laptop/badge timing + benefits session timing.

anya_recruiter: Maya prefers remote morning then onsite afternoon for badge if that helps. Her passport is fine but SSN card delayed.

maya_newhire: Hi all! I can do a mobile notary in my city Wed, but Tue/Wed travel makes in-person within 3 days tricky. Can we grant temporary access to complete onboarding tasks?

kevin_peopleops: Options: 1) Mobile notary + secure upload + follow-up in person within 3 business days; 2) If not possible, submit compliance exception for time-limited access with restricted SSO scopes. We'll try #1 first.

kevin_peopleops: Quick checklist to confirm owners:
- Mobile notary intake & portal upload instructions: @kevin_peopleops
- Badge kiosk reservation & escort (if onsite): @felix_it
- Laptop ship/hold: @felix_it
- Background check monitor: @anya_recruiter
- Regional benefits recording + 1:1: @kevin_peopleops

felix_it: I'll reserve a Tue 2:30pm kiosk slot in SF and put a hold on the laptop courier until we get verification. If mobile notary occurs, upload before courier dispatch.

jordan_mentor: I can meet Maya at kiosk if she can make it. Otherwise remote buddy intro is fine.

maya_newhire: Where exactly do I upload notarized docs? And is mobile notary acceptable from outside US? (I'm currently traveling within US but may have to use consulate if abroad.)

kevin_peopleops: Upload to https://redwood-secure/hr-upload -> New Hire Docs. Mobile notary within US is acceptable. International notary/consulate needs additional review by compliance; flag it here and we'll help.

hr-portal-bot: New Hire folder created for Maya (maya_newhire). Link sent via DM.

kevin_peopleops: Action confirmations please: react with :white_check_mark: when youre good on your item. If mobile notary isn't possible within 3 days we'll open a compliance exception and issue limited access token set. Thanks!
